window._note: Sample window: 8 weeks from the day the tool was made available to the pilot population.

thresholds._note: Thresholds for every Success Metrics Framework signal. Every [X]/[Y] placeholder in the framework lives here, never in the engine script. Values below are starting points for the team to set at baseline.

active_usage._def: Active Usage Rate: share of target users with at least min_uses_per_period uses in the trailing period_days.

sustained_use._def: Sustained use: the first day a user's trailing within_days count reaches uses. Time-to-Sustained-Use counts from first use to that day.

usage_drop._def: Usage Drop: trailing compare_days count fell by drop_pct or more against the prior compare_days, for users whose prior window had at least min_prior_uses.

adoption_plateau._def: Adoption Plateau: first use at least after_days ago, sustained use never reached, and trailing 14-day count no higher than the user's first 14 days.

zero_use._def: Zero-Use Persistence: no logged use after_days or more after the tool was available to the user.

feature_depth._def: Feature Utilization Depth: distinct agents used over the trailing 28 days, as a share of available_agents.

manager_engagement._def: Manager Dashboard Engagement: a manager counts as engaged with engaged_min_views or more dashboard opens in the trailing period.

intervention_effect._def: Intervention Effectiveness: usage in the lift_window_days after an intervention fired exceeds usage in the same span before it.

team_variance._def: Team Adoption Variance: population standard deviation of per-user use counts over lookback_days, per manager.

Active Usage Rate.needs: per user per day: count of uses (conversations or messages)

Time-to-First-Use.needs: per user: seat granted date; first logged use

Time-to-Sustained-Use.needs: per user per day use counts (derived)

Workflow Deviation Rate.needs: not in usage telemetry; needs process observation or a self-report field

Escalation Pattern Shift.needs: case or call routing data from the pilot team's own system

Feature Utilization Depth.needs: per use: which agent or skill was used; list of available agents

Manager Dashboard Engagement.needs: access log of the manager report: who opened it, when

Coaching Conversation Rate.needs: manager-logged conversation date per at-risk user (self-report form)

Usage Drop.needs: derived from per user per day counts

Sustained Workaround.needs: process observation or self-report; no telemetry equivalent
